source_caption_text:
Never forget when Nicki Minajs interviewer put her in her place 😭😂😂

Nicki Minaj was interviewing Sachin for a job, but he came prepared to put HER to work 😭😭

During their 2021 Instagram Live, the fan known as Sach made it clear that if he worked for Nicki, he would make sure she stayed focused and got her music finished in the studio. What started as a conversation about a job quickly turned into him explaining how he’d keep the boss on schedule 😂

That’s what makes this exchange so funny—Sachin was speaking as a fan who wanted the music, while also making his case for why she should hire him. He wasn’t just there to agree with everything she said; he already had a priority in mind.

Nicki thought she was checking his qualifications and ended up getting a preview of her own performance review 😭💀 Would you hire someone this honest?
